title: acisanthera ayangannae
intro: Acisanthera ayangannae, commonly known as the "Ayanna's Acisanthera" or "African Acisanthera", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. The health benefits of Acisanthera ayangannae include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions.
